text: [haughty] Hey, fleet! This route is my turf. Pay a toll of ₡{X} and I'll let you pass.
[haughty] Oh, nice ships. If you don't want scratches, pay ₡{X}. Business is business.
[haughty] Humans daring to come this far. Pay ₡{X} for your lives — I'll spare you today.
[haughty] ₡{X} is cheaper than the bounty on your head, isn't it? Choose.
[haughty] Don't you care about your ships? Pay ₡{X} and I look away. Refuse... you'll regret it.
